platforms.linkedin: native summary; the dev.to link goes in the first comment

tags_per_post.devto_format: dev.to tags: at most 4, lowercase letters and digits only (no spaces or hyphens)

exclusions.current_employer: Never discuss current-employer details or projects. Current employer = the employment.json role with end: null.

notes: Run /extrovert configure to fill news_fields and adjust the ban list.

limits.note: Mostly unofficial sources (no official LinkedIn or GitHub page found); confirm in each editor. LinkedIn's About folds behind 'see more' after roughly 230-370 characters: the hook goes first. Medium's About page has no published character limit (Medium only says the limit was raised): 1,300 is our own cap, the same reading length as LinkedIn's About.
limits.devto_note: dev.to (Forem): summary max 200, text fields 100, text areas 200 (profile_validator.rb). Work is a text field; Skills/Languages and Currently hacking on are text areas: confirm in the editor.

policy.source: template default: remind when a top-impact public entry is added or changes, the top 5 public entries change, the job or role changes, or a new skill group appears; at most once every 14 days except job or role changes

profiles.current_employer_rule: Same level as the public PDF (employment.json public_summary + public_context) until the user lifts this rule.

role_attribution.source: user: which role an entry belongs to when its dates don't say
